language_context.national_language_note: Putonghua (Standard Mandarin) and standardized Chinese characters are identified by the PRC as the national common spoken and written language.
language_context.diversity_note: China is home to 56 officially recognized ethnic groups and extensive linguistic diversity. The Ministry of Education describes multiple language families, regional Sinitic varieties, and minority languages. A language family, language, and dialect/variety must not be conflated.
language_context.classification_note: Some Sinitic varieties traditionally called fangyan are not mutually intelligible. LWT records their specific names and scholarly classification notes rather than assuming every variety is mutually intelligible with Mandarin.
